device.note: Android adds request_id and report_problems to every error; Apple sends error, message and reason only. Extra fields the code names (setting, permission, retry_after_s and so on) ride beside them.

access_needed.agent_should: Tell the owner; Bridgit also notifies them

account_required.meaning: A verified linked account is required
account_required.agent_should: Link this phone to the owner account

agent_not_allowed.meaning: This agent lacks a capability grant
agent_not_allowed.agent_should: Ask the owner to change agent permissions

agents_may_not_change.meaning: The owner turned off agent changes to this applet's budget

allowance_exhausted.meaning: The device's held allowance for this source has no room left for this spend in the current period (`reason`, `resets_at`)
allowance_exhausted.agent_should: Wait for `resets_at`, or raise the budget or move a share to this device; don't retry unchanged

allowance_expired.meaning: The device's held allowance for this source has run out of time and no newer one has arrived
allowance_expired.agent_should: Retry once the device has fetched a new allowance; an expired one never comes back

already_named.meaning: This Bridgit already has its Device Domain Name for good (`name`)
already_named.agent_should: Use that name; change only label or visible

applet_budget.meaning: An installed applet's budget is used up for this period on all the owner's phones (`applet`, `limit`, `resets_at`)
applet_budget.agent_should: Don't retry before resets_at; an agent with Budgets can top it up or raise the limit (PUT /v1/applets/{id}/budget)

approval_declined.meaning: The phone was locked and the owner denied, or didn't answer within 30 s, the Allow prompt for this photo (`reason`: declined or no_answer)
approval_declined.agent_should: Don't retry automatically; ask the owner

approver_unreachable.meaning: No approver device could be reached for a call that needs one
approver_unreachable.agent_should: Retry later; the owner may need to open Bridgit on an approver device

approver_unverified.meaning: The approver asked hasn't itself verified that approver device's keys
approver_unverified.agent_should: Use an approver device that verified it; don't retry unchanged

budget_reached.meaning: An installed applet's own spending cap for cloud model calls is used up (day or month)
budget_reached.agent_should: Wait for the next day or month, or ask the owner to raise the applet's limit in Installed applets

callback_failed.meaning: Your callback URL didn't accept the test event (`http_status` or `reason` field)
callback_failed.agent_should: Check the receiver; the owner sees the host in Activity

capability_disabled.agent_should: Tell the owner which switch (`setting` field)

capture_cancelled.meaning: The owner cancelled, deleted or closed the capture review
capture_cancelled.agent_should: Wait for a new deliberate capture; do not retry automatically

claim_required.meaning: This pairing link expired before it was claimed (relay)
claim_required.agent_should: Update the Bridgit app and pair again with a new link

cloud_unreachable.meaning: The Bridgit cloud couldn't be reached, and this spend is from an instrument only the cloud can use
cloud_unreachable.agent_should: Retry later; work that costs nothing still runs

code_expired.meaning: That link code expired (codes last 10 minutes)

code_invalid.meaning: Wrong link code; 5 wrong tries void a code
code_invalid.agent_should: Check the code with the owner; don't guess

code_used_up.meaning: That link code was already used, cancelled, or voided after 5 wrong tries

conflict.meaning: The interaction isn't in a state for this (for example a text panel that's closed or finished)
conflict.agent_should: Read it with GET /v1/interactions/{id}; start a new one if needed

consent_expired.agent_should: Ask for a new owner-approved grant

email_required.meaning: The first 24 hours are over and the owner hasn't verified an email (`state`: none or pending)
email_required.agent_should: Send the owner's address with POST /v1/owner/email, then ask them to tap the link in the email

export_too_large.meaning: An export exceeds its row, photo or 20 MB size limit
export_too_large.agent_should: Use paginated applet rows and individual saved photos, or filter a share report; don't retry unchanged

forbidden.meaning: Not allowed for this agent (`reason`, for example `fixer_mode_off` or `super_powers_off`: the owner hasn't given you Bridgit Fixer Mode or Agent Super Powers; `agent_paused`: the owner paused you)
forbidden.agent_should: Don't retry; for `agent_paused`, wait until the owner resumes you

forbidden_source.meaning: Caller is not on the tailnet

friendly_name_required.meaning: Registering a Device Domain Name also needs the friendly name, in the same step
friendly_name_required.agent_should: Send friendly_name (up to 40 characters, any style) with name

friendly_name_taken.meaning: Another of this owner's devices already has that friendly name (`friendly_name`, `held_by`)
friendly_name_taken.agent_should: Pick a different friendly name; nothing was registered

idempotency_conflict.meaning: This image key was used for different parameters

idempotency_expired.meaning: Same `Idempotency-Key` already done, but its media result is no longer replayed (15 min)
idempotency_expired.agent_should: Don't repeat; use a new key only if you really want a new capture

image_in_progress.meaning: Image request is pending or its outcome is unknown
image_in_progress.agent_should: Retry only with the same Idempotency-Key

image_outcome_unknown.meaning: Image generation outcome could not be confirmed
image_outcome_unknown.agent_should: Retry only with the same Idempotency-Key

image_provider_failed.meaning: Azure could not generate the image
image_provider_failed.agent_should: Inspect provider_status; never retry an unknown outcome with a new key

image_quota_exceeded.meaning: The account used its 40 monthly images

image_refused.meaning: Azure refused the request without using an image slot
image_refused.agent_should: Correct the request before starting a new generation

images_unavailable.meaning: The configured Azure image task is unavailable
images_unavailable.agent_should: Check the configured model task and Azure deployment

in_progress.agent_should: Wait, then retry with the same key

internal_error.agent_should: File a bug report directly with Bridgit servers (Issues Tracking): https://bridgit.cc/learn/bugs.md

link_approval_declined.meaning: A device in the wild asked for something that needs the owner's Allow, and the owner denied it or didn't answer within 30 s (`reason`)

link_expired.meaning: That link's access ended: an associate's or a device in the wild's grant passed its end date (`link_id`, `tier`)
link_expired.agent_should: Don't retry; ask the owner to renew it or link again

link_paused.agent_should: Wait until it is resumed; don't retry before then

link_revoked.meaning: The link with that Bridgit was disconnected (`scope`: direction or link, `link_id`)
link_revoked.agent_should: Don't retry; linking again needs a new link code

link_waiting.meaning: Only one Bridgit has opted in to that direction so far (`waiting_for`: user or target)
link_waiting.agent_should: Ask the other side's owner or agent to opt in; GET /v1/owner/configuration/links shows the states

media_incomplete.meaning: That photo or video is still arriving (being recorded, downloaded or synced); list with include_pending=true to see it as complete:false
media_incomplete.agent_should: Wait a few seconds and retry

model_not_ready.meaning: An on-phone engine you named isn't downloaded yet (`engine`, `state`: downloading, waiting_for_wifi or failed, `size_mb`, `retry_after_s`); the request started the download
model_not_ready.agent_should: Retry after retry_after_s; GET /v1/images/engines shows progress

model_unavailable.meaning: The selected registered model is unavailable or incompatible
model_unavailable.agent_should: Read the effective model preference; clear the override to inherit a valid default

name_required.meaning: This Bridgit needs a Device Domain Name first (the message has the naming advice)
name_required.agent_should: Register one with POST /v1/owner/configuration/name, then retry

name_taken.meaning: That Device Domain Name belongs to another Bridgit (`lookup`)
name_taken.agent_should: Suggest another name; don't retry unchanged

namespace_mismatch.meaning: A spend, a budget or a cap names another accounting namespace (`live` or `sandbox`) than its source or instrument has
namespace_mismatch.agent_should: Leave `namespace` out or send the source's own; a sandbox source never spends live money, or the reverse

no_approver.meaning: This needs an owner authorization and no approver device that can give it is enrolled
no_approver.agent_should: Ask the owner to enrol an approver device; don't retry until then

no_person_found.meaning: view people found nobody in the frame; nothing was returned or kept (source_width_px, source_height_px)
no_person_found.agent_should: Reframe and retry, or ask for view full

no_screen_lock.meaning: That device has no screen lock, so it can't be an approver device
no_screen_lock.agent_should: Ask the owner to set a screen lock on it, or use another device

not_on_satellite.meaning: This endpoint can't run on a satellite (yet), or the satellite doesn't offer it
not_on_satellite.agent_should: Leave out the target, or use another endpoint

not_on_target.meaning: That call doesn't pass a link: the endpoint, the target's service list, or a call that already came over a link (calls pass on once)
not_on_target.agent_should: Leave out the target, or link that Bridgit directly

not_shared.meaning: The applet's package doesn't share that table with you (share_with_installer)
not_shared.agent_should: Read the applet's card on the phone instead, or ship a revision that shares it

not_supported.meaning: Android doesn't allow this (for example Wi-Fi toggle)

notifications_required.meaning: Bridgit's notifications are off, so captures are refused
notifications_required.agent_should: Tell the owner to turn notifications on

offline.meaning: The device reaches no network, so something that needs one can't run now (a spend that needs its provider or the cloud, for example)
offline.agent_should: Retry when the device is back online; work that needs no network still runs

out_of_range.meaning: every_s is outside the action's min_s..max_s

over_ceiling.meaning: The new limit (or limit plus top-ups) would pass the owner's ceiling for agents (`ceiling`)
over_ceiling.agent_should: Stay within the ceiling, or ask the owner to raise it

owner_authorization_required.meaning: Only the owner can decide this, on an approver device; an agent can ask, read and decline
owner_authorization_required.agent_should: Don't retry; tell the owner what is waiting (`remaining_human_step`)

owner_email_required.meaning: A verified owner alert email is needed before an approver device is enrolled or an approver recovery starts
owner_email_required.agent_should: Set it with POST /v1/owner/email; the owner opens the link in that email, then retry

pairing_closed.agent_should: Ask the owner to open one

payload_too_large.agent_should: Ask for a smaller size (`photo_id` given)

permission_denied.agent_should: Tell the owner; More > Hardware access fixes it

phone_unreachable.meaning: (Relay) phone didn't pick up the job

photo_not_found.meaning: Gallery item gone or outside access

platform_unsupported.meaning: This platform can't do that (a named gap, for example approving on a desktop install)
platform_unsupported.agent_should: Don't retry; use a device whose profile offers it

quota_exceeded.meaning: Daily data, file storage or relay job quota used up (`limit`)
quota_exceeded.agent_should: Remove old transfers or wait for retention

raise_the_ceiling_first.meaning: An owner's raise does not fit the room under the budget's agent ceiling that no headroom balance holds
raise_the_ceiling_first.agent_should: Raise the ceiling first (POST /v1/owner/configuration/spending/budgets/{id}/gate), then raise the budget

recovery_complete.meaning: The approver recovery already cleared the approver list, so it can't be cancelled
recovery_complete.agent_should: Don't retry; enrol a first approver device again

row_not_found.meaning: That row of the applet's table isn't there (deleted, or dropped past max_rows or keep_days)
row_not_found.agent_should: Read the rows again; don't retry unchanged

satellite_offline.agent_should: Retry later; the owner may need to check the satellite's Tailscale

sensor_busy.meaning: Sensor in use or capture running
sensor_busy.agent_should: Retry once after a few seconds

service_start_blocked.meaning: Android hasn't given the service this sensor
service_start_blocked.agent_should: Ask the owner to open Bridgit once

setting_locked.meaning: Agents can't change this setting (`key`, `reason`: gate, disconnects, owner_only, android or status)
setting_locked.agent_should: Ask the owner to change it on the phone

share_unavailable.meaning: Android's share sheet couldn't open (Bridgit isn't on screen)
share_unavailable.agent_should: Ask the owner to open Bridgit and tap the button again

signed_requests_required.meaning: The owner allows only sealed (signed) relay requests for agents that can control the phone (relay)
signed_requests_required.agent_should: Switch to sealed mode, or ask the owner

speech_cloud_consent_required.meaning: Selected speech model needs explicit cloud permission

speech_model_changed.meaning: Registry selection changed during this turn
speech_model_changed.agent_should: Resolve again before a new turn

speech_no_match.meaning: No speech was recognized during this bounded turn
speech_no_match.agent_should: Start a new turn when ready to speak

speech_unavailable.meaning: Selected speech engine or backend is unavailable

spend_bridgit_cap.meaning: A Bridgit-funded cap has no room for this spend, as the cloud last reported it (`rule` 5, `resets_at`)
spend_bridgit_cap.agent_should: Wait for `resets_at`; an owner or an agent cannot raise a Bridgit-funded cap

spend_not_allowed.meaning: This agent or applet may not spend here: the device does not let it act, or a value transfer lacks `payments.request` (`rule` 2, `reason`)

spend_over_budget.meaning: An owner budget has no room left in this device's portion for the period (`rule` 6, `resets_at`)
spend_over_budget.agent_should: Wait for `resets_at`, or top the budget up or raise it (POST /v1/owner/configuration/spending/budgets/{id}/topups); don't retry unchanged

spend_over_cap.meaning: The spend is above the per-spend cap of its source or instrument (`rule` 4)
spend_over_cap.agent_should: Ask for less, or raise the cap with POST /v1/owner/configuration/spending/rules; don't retry unchanged

spend_source_not_allowed.meaning: The source is not linked on this device, or the model or route is not one that source allows (`rule` 3, `reason`)
spend_source_not_allowed.agent_should: Link the source (POST /v1/owner/configuration/spending/sources) or use an allowed route; don't retry unchanged

spending_off.meaning: Spending is switched off for this spend: outside calls are paused, or spending is off for the instrument class or the source (`rule` 1, `reason`)
spending_off.agent_should: Tell the owner which switch; an agent with the configuration grant can turn it back on with POST /v1/owner/configuration/spending. Don't retry unchanged

target_not_granted.meaning: The owner hasn't let this agent use that satellite
target_not_granted.agent_should: Ask the owner (Devices > the satellite > Agents)

target_offline.agent_should: Retry later; its owner may need to check Tailscale or Bridgit on it

team_unavailable.meaning: The Bridgit team backend can't be reached
team_unavailable.agent_should: Retry later, or register at the backend directly

tier_not_allowed.meaning: That link's trust tier doesn't allow this call (`tier`: own, associate or public)
tier_not_allowed.agent_should: Use only what the link lists in services; ask the owner to change the tier

too_many_open.agent_should: Wait for answers or cancel some

transfer_not_for_recipient.meaning: That move of budget room names another device as its recipient, so this one can't take it
transfer_not_for_recipient.agent_should: Give it to the device it names, or ask the sender for a new move; don't retry

unauthorized.meaning: Key missing or wrong; `reason` = `key_rotated` or `agent_removed` when Bridgit knows
unauthorized.agent_should: Stop; tell the owner the key needs replacing

unknown_target.meaning: No linked Bridgit or satellite with that name or id (`target`); GET /v1/links lists them
unknown_target.agent_should: Fix the target, or leave it out to use this phone

upstream_failed.meaning: A service Bridgit asks on your behalf (MET Norway for weather) failed and nothing was cached (`service`, `upstream_status` or `reason`)

viewfinder_required.meaning: The visible camera viewfinder is required but cannot be shown for this action
viewfinder_required.agent_should: Open Bridgit and use the visible capture/review flow; do not fall back to hidden capture

wrong_device.meaning: This agent's key is locked to another Tailscale device (device lock)
wrong_device.agent_should: Call from the device you were set up on, or ask the owner to allow this device; don't retry
